evidence.section: Vickers microhardness and tensile performance of welded joints
evidence.quote: The average Vickers microhardness of the FZ of the joint with LBO = +0.3 is 183.9 ± 4.4 HV, which represents an increase of 16.8% and 54.8% compared to Nb521 and pure Ti, respectively.

evidence.section: Vickers microhardness and tensile performance of welded joints
evidence.quote: The average Vickers microhardness in the FZ is 149.2 ± 10.4 HV, which is 5.3% lower than that of Nb521 BM.

evidence.section: Vickers microhardness and tensile performance of welded joints
